stops.note: a familiar name the Janissaries gave respected elders among them
from 1671 the Janissary garrison of Algiers elected its own ruler under this title
in 1827 Dey Hussein struck the French consul with a fly-whisk, the pretext for France's conquest of Algiers in 1830
used by English traders and treaty-makers dealing with the Barbary states

current_meaning: the title of the rulers of Ottoman Algiers (and at times Tunis and Tripoli) until 1830
